description:
Title: TPF Developer 
 Location: Atlanta, GA 
 Duration: Long term 
 No. of positions:- 03 
   
 Key Responsibilities 
 • Primary Functions:
 o Develops high level designs and solutions, sometimes across multiple
 platforms
 o Provides guidance and leadership to less experienced developers
 within the group
 o Work with peers in Product, development, Commercial, outside vendors
 such as IBM
 o Creates software specification requirements into appropriate
 programming languages.
 o Be available 24x7 one week per month to troubleshoot and correct any
 urgent customer impacting problem within your area of responsibility
 o Provides project estimates and planning functions for management
 o Analyses user requirements, researching, designing and writing new
 software programs or developing existing programs by analyzing and
 identifying areas for modification.
  
 • Additional Functions 
 o Writing operational documentation
 o Writing and testing code and then refining and rewriting as necessary.
 o Reviews, tests and evaluates new versions of operating systems and
 related software.
 o Develops and maintains an understanding of business needs and
 objectives to ensure timely responsiveness within assigned areas of
 responsibility.
 o Prepares regular reports on all assigned activities as required by
 supervisor.
  
  
 Key Skills Expertise 
 o Provides technical assistance to applications programming,
 communications, network, and operating systems personnel.
 • Advanced degree (or equivalent experience) in
 the computer sciences
 • 5-10 years in advanced computer systems or
 software systems development
 • 5+ years developing in one or more of the
 Client critical infrastructures
 • Ability to work in all phases of system design
 and delivery
 • Demonstrated ability to effectively create and
 execute technical infrastructure
 • Strong PC skills including knowledge of
 Microsoft Office products
 • Ability to perform multiple tasks concurrently
 under pressure
 • Excellent customer service attitude,
 communication skills (written and verbal), and
 interpersonal skills
 • Experience with z/9 or z/10 mainframes, zTPF,
 • Ability to work in multiple phases of system
 design and delivery
 • Ability to develop communications related
 software in one or more programming
 languages: BAL, C, C++, Java, on one or more
 platforms: TPF, Windows, Linux, AIX, and Websphere
